activity_summary: After the call you wrote the hiring into your tables. The two boys are three shillings the week and not paid. Sincler is the messenger. John is the schoolmaster. The page is not named. The dairymaid stays. The gown is written down as wanted, and not bought.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the count in his own hand.

facets.activity: Wrote the hiring on the tables
